assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Reddens if the resume advice omits any blocking finding's id, file or text, or names the follow-on's; the expected ids are re-derived from each finding's own file/line/text in _expected_id, so the oracle is independent of the module's mint, and the declared mutation (advice composing every finding) would redden the absent-direction asserts.
Fails when more than one repair round is opened for the review round; shown red at 'assert 3 == 1' under the declared mutation that opens one round per finding.
Cannot fail on a round-id regression: both sides are set from the same round_id by one _record_repair_delta write, so the assertion is true for whatever id the composer mints.

Reddens if a retry starts a new round rather than incrementing the attempt of the round in hand; line 351 (second vs first round_id) is a same-write comparison, while lines 349-350 (attempt 2, count still 1) carry the guard.
